experiments.name: v4 preflop over-folding analysis
experiments.result: folds 90% to small raises (<=3BB) ~ same as to all-ins; BB vs small raise folds 85% (std 40-55%); unopened CO 87%, BTN 72%; folded AK on BTN vs 3BB, KQs/JTs in BB, 99 in SB unopened. Cause: price-blind (any raise = strength), v4 survival rules over-generalized from all-ins to all raises, Qwen cautious, single-hand reward favors folding. Fix added to v8: price-aware preflop + BB defense + never fold premiums to small raises.
